subject: docs: add ModelManager spec (#3768)
summary: Adds a 1283-line architecture spec (docs/dev/specs/model-management.md) that refactors the ModelManager into multiple components — ModelStore, ModelSyncService, ModelIngest, ArtifactSource/Resolver, FetchableRepository, ModelChangeNotifier, and RecipeOptionsStore — plus updates the mkdocs navigation to include it.
verdict_reason: Pure documentation-only change that received a thorough, subject-matter-expert review from @jeremyfowers, with all questions resolved and CI passing cleanly.
